versions.short: The resolution finds Michael Joseph in contempt of Congress for refusing to comply with two subpoenas issued to him by the Committee on Ethics: one requiring him to produce documents and one requiring him to appear before an Investigative Subcommittee. It directs the Speaker of the House to certify the committee's report on his refusal to the United States Attorney for the District of Columbia so that he can be proceeded against as provided by law, and it instructs the Speaker to take all other appropriate action to enforce the subpoenas.
